_meta.name: replay
_meta.note: Durable session replay preserves append order and curated visible timeline facts. It never copies canonical payloads, tool arguments or results, raw stream frames, memory internals, or canvas-only paint hints.
_meta.reserved_note: Approval decisions are not canonical spine event types yet. Add the vocabulary event first, then promote the mapping into replay.
